ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Colonist race
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that give a colonist a Biotech xenotype, and that generate a colonist from any humanlike PawnKindDef (the way to reach a race a mod adds). Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See ColonistRace/README.md at the repository root.
They sit under a text of their own ("Nelim's Pickle Tools: ...") so they can never be ambiguous with Pickle's steps; when the same steps land in Pickle this mod's can go.
